key_insight: QAOA and FALQON follow distinct entanglement and coherence trajectories as they approach Minimum Vertex Cover solutions.
engineering_relevance: Tracking these resources without full state tomography could help characterize quantum optimization circuits for near-term devices.
method: Apply QAOA and FALQON to Minimum Vertex Cover.
Optimize auxiliary circuits to identify closest resource-free states.
Quantify Bures entanglement and coherence using Uhlmann’s theorem.
evidence_signal: For the considered instance, QAOA shows an early entanglement peak and residual coherence, while FALQON shows a lower, later entanglement peak and smoothly decreasing coherence.
watch_item: Results concern one problem instance; broader generalization and auxiliary-circuit optimization costs remain to be assessed.
paper_title: Resource Analysis of Quantum Optimization Algorithms via Variational Methods
